cpsc.why: Brand plus product-name overlap only. The record has no UPC and no Model value, so INTENT principle 2 forbids high. Upgrade to high only if the user adds the NL311 identifier as a model number.
Real CPSC data error: Title says Joolz but the record is CooCooBaby baby loungers. Matching on Title alone would raise a false alert. Match on Products[].Name and Description too.
